generationPromptZh: 一个带前向镜头、握柄和顶部取景框的箱形相机。它由机身、前镜头、侧握柄和顶部取景框组成。镜头深度约为机身深度的0.80倍，并沿前向连接机身。宽深比约1.89，高/最大水平跨度约0.71；顶部快门位于侧握柄上，镜头握柄间距与身宽比0.64。实测采用4种不透明颜色，机身以蓝灰色为主，镜头端面呈青色。正视看前侧轮廓，侧视看纵深及附件连接，俯视看水平排列和间距；斜视同时显示前面、右侧与顶部，孔隙与接合均来自实体几何。 采用彩色体素。坐标为0至47的整数，X左右、Y向上、Z前后；实际接地最低Y为0。占用750至1250个唯一体素，RGB为0至255整数；保持单一六邻域连通、真实开口及面连接。不要添加展示底板、文字、背景、噪声或悬浮装饰。 原始参数规格：{"baseWidthFraction": 0.55, "category": "camera", "changedAttributes": ["width", "depth", "height", "supportInset", "shapeChamfer", "featureCount"], "construction": "original continuous boxes and chamfered cross sections", "depth": 6.0, "detailPosition": 0.25, "featureCount": 2, "height": 10.0, "instance": 0, "lipOverhang": 0.6, "neckFraction": 0.42, "ordinal": 55236, "redesign": 0, "rimHeight": 2.0, "shapeChamfer": 0.0, "shoulderFraction": 0.58, "structureIndex": 0, "style": 0, "supportInset": 1.0, "variant": 1, "wallThickness": 2.0, "width": 16.0}
generationPromptEn: A box camera with a forward lens, grip and top viewfinder. It includes a body, forward lens, side grip and top viewfinder. Lens depth is 0.80 body-depths, extending forward from the connected body. Width/depth is 1.89; height/horizontal-span is 0.71. The shutter sits on top of the grip. Lens/grip-spacing/width is 0.64. Across 4 opaque colors, the body is mainly blue-gray and the lens-face is cyan. Front and side views expose contours and attachment joins; top and oblique views reveal spacing and upper surfaces. Use colored voxels at unique integer coordinates from 0 through 47, with X left to right, Y upward and Z front to back. Real ground contact starts at Y zero. Use 750 through 1250 occupied voxels and integer RGB values from 0 through 255. Keep one six neighbor component, real openings and face connected parts. Add no display base, text, background, noise or floating ornaments.
